title: The generative media map
intro: Three axes that tell you which model to reach for — and what you'll pay in quality, latency, and cost.

steps.title: Beyond text
steps.body:
LLMs cracked text and code. **Generative media** extends that to everything else we perceive: image, video, audio, music.

The practical question is never "which model is best?" — it's **which model, for this app, at what quality/latency/cost**. The course's answer: place every model on three axes.

steps.title: Modality and scope
steps.body:
- **Modality**: *unimodal* (same in → same out, e.g. image super-resolution), *cross-modal* (text→image, text→video), *multimodal* (many in, many out). More modalities, broader apps.
- **Scope**: *specialized* models go deep on one domain — Lyria for music, Veo for video with audio. *General-purpose* models (Gemini) trade that depth for breadth across tasks.

steps.title: The paradigm axis
steps.body: How the pixels actually get made:

points.label: Autoregressive
points.note: Sequential, token by token — the LLM recipe (encode → generate → decode). Excels at instruction following, compositional accuracy, fine control.

points.label: Diffusion
points.note: Noise → refine, whole output each pass, in latent space (condition → denoise → decode). A sculptor carving detail. Excels at fidelity, texture, coherence.

points.label: Hybrid
points.note: The real power: autoregressive lays global structure, diffusion finishes the detail. Input → [AR] → [diffusion] → output.

steps.title: Using the map
steps.body:
Control problems (the model ignores instructions, miscounts objects) point at **autoregressive strengths**. Fidelity problems (mushy textures, incoherent detail) point at **diffusion strengths**.

> [!tip] The axes aren't trivia — they're the vocabulary every later decision uses: what to prompt for, what to evaluate, and where an agent's retries should aim.

recap:
**Three axes place any generative media model.**

- Modality: unimodal / cross-modal / multimodal — breadth of I/O.
- Scope: specialized (deep) vs general-purpose (broad).
- Paradigm: autoregressive (control) vs diffusion (fidelity) — hybrids combine both.
- Every choice is a quality ⚖️ latency ⚖️ cost trade.
